name: sailantis/azera-framework
description: A lightweight, fast PHP framework for building modern web and cli applications. Azera combines the best ideas from frameworks like Phalcon, CodeIgniter, Laravel and Twig into a minimal yet powerful toolkit.

suggest.mongodb/mongodb: Required for MongoDB document persistence (Azera\Orm\Storage\MongoStore) — install together with the ext-mongodb PHP extension. Optional: only tests/MongoLiveTest.php needs the real package; all other Mongo tests run against an in-memory fake
suggest.ext-mongodb: PHP driver for MongoDB document persistence (Azera\Orm\Storage\MongoStore)
